title: Microsoft Purview or Standalone DLP Tools: Protecting Data Inside and Outside Microsoft 365
excerpt: Microsoft Purview brings data loss prevention into Microsoft 365; standalone DLP products aim to cover many platforms. The best choice depends on where your sensitive data actually lives.
verdict: Purview is the natural choice for organisations that keep most of their data in Microsoft 365, with one console and native integration. Standalone DLP tools fit better in diverse environments with significant data in systems outside the Microsoft ecosystem.

spec1.label: Microsoft 365 integration
spec1.device1Value: Native, as part of the same platform
